import fs from'node:fs';import{createHook}from'node:async_hooks';import{createExactProducedResponse}from'./baseline-body.mjs';import{writeNodeResponse as baseline}from'./baseline-handler.mjs';import{writeNodeResponse as sync}from'./sync-handler.mjs';
const rows=[];for(const[name,write]of[['baseline',baseline],['sync',sync]]){for(let i=0;i<2000;i++)await write({setHeader(){},end(){}},createExactProducedResponse(200,{},w=>w('hello')));let promises=0;const hook=createHook({init(id,type){if(type==='PROMISE')promises++;}});hook.enable();for(let i=0;i<1000;i++)await write({setHeader(){},end(){}},createExactProducedResponse(200,{},w=>w('hello')));hook.disable();rows.push({name,requests:1000,promises});}fs.writeFileSync('.tmp/ssr-followthrough/promises.json',JSON.stringify(rows));console.log(rows);
